blocks.text: Conversational forms that turn data collection into engagement

Typeform pioneered the one-question-at-a-time format that makes filling out forms feel more like a conversation than a chore. This design philosophy consistently produces higher completion rates - often 2-3x compared to traditional forms - which directly impacts lead quality and volume.

For teams running lead qualification, Typeform's branching logic creates personalized paths through your form. A marketing agency might ask different follow-up questions based on company size, while a SaaS company might route prospects to different outcomes based on their needs. The experience feels custom-built for each respondent.

The integration ecosystem is mature and reliable. Typeform connects natively to HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, and dozens of other tools, making it easy to route qualified leads into your pipeline without manual data entry.
Conversational format that shows one question per screen for higher engagement
Create branching paths that personalize the experience per respondent
Embed videos, images, and GIFs within your form questions
Build scoring models, quizzes, and ROI calculators
Connect to HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Sheets, and more
Match your brand with custom colors, fonts, and layouts
When conversion rate on a form matters - lead gen, customer onboarding, feedback collection - Typeform's conversational approach consistently outperforms traditional forms in our client projects.
Our team can integrate Typeform into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
